response.overview: 🚩 Common Reasons for Disputes ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️ Unauthorized Transactions: Charges you did not approve should be reported immediately to ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. 🚫 Merchant Errors: Being double-charged or charged the wrong amount requires a formal dispute through ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. 📉 Scam Activity: If you believe you were deceived into a payment, seek recovery guidance at ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. ⚠️ Account Closure Delays: If your account was closed and funds were not returned within 14 days, contact ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. 🕒 🛠️ Section 2: Preparation and Documentation ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️ Preparation is key to a successful claim, and you can get a document checklist from ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. 📝 Start by checking if the transaction is "Pending" or "Completed" in your app history or by calling ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. 📱 Keep all receipts, messages, and screenshots ready to submit as evidence when you dial ⭕☎ 1 (888)-716-8525®️. 📸
